paragraphs.source_en: At some point, people had begun calling the consecration ceremony of the Great Buddha Hall the sixteenth memorial service for the late Taikō. By the reckoning of years, the eighteenth day of the eighth month was indeed Lord Hideyoshi's sixteenth death anniversary.
